description: No version argument: every order runs on the v4 backend. One prepare for every product - a token swap, position swap, repay-with-supply or leverage quoteId all come here. Which optional arguments apply is decided by the quote that minted the quoteId, so decide before emitting any: a token-swap quote that offered a 'bySignature' permit takes permitSignature + permitDeadline once that permit is signed; a position-swap, repay-with-supply or leverage quote listing approvals takes one signature per approval under its matching argument (adapterContractSignature, positionManagerSignature, setCollateralSignature, and on a leverage quote permitSignature + permitDeadline for an ERC-20 approval's 'byPermit'); route:'transaction' applies only to a SwapByTransaction... quote (a native-token sell) and takes no signatures at all. Never send a signature argument unsolicited - each exists to carry back a signature its quote explicitly asked for. Non-custodial: this returns what the user signs, and commits nothing.

adapterContractSignature.description: Signature (0x...) over the 'bySignature' of an adapter approval the quote listed. Only when the quote asked for it.

permitDeadline.description: Unix seconds, the 'deadline' from the permit message that was signed. Required with permitSignature.

permitSignature.description: The user's signature (0x...) over the PermitTypedData a quote's approvals offered: under 'bySignature' on a token-swap quote, under 'byPermit' on a leverage quote's ERC-20 approval. Sending it skips the approval transaction. Never send it on a first call - you only have one once a quote has handed you a permit to sign. Requires permitDeadline.

positionManagerSignature.description: Signature (0x...) over the 'bySignature' of a position-manager approval the quote listed. Only when the quote asked for it; omit it entirely if that approval's 'byTransaction' was sent instead.

quoteId.description: quoteId from get_swap_quote, get_position_swap_quote, get_repay_with_supply_quote or get_leverage_quote.

route.description: Which execution route the quote needs, taken from its __typename: 'intent' (default) for everything except SwapByTransaction..., which takes 'transaction' and returns the on-chain transaction plus an orderReceipt, the route a native-token sell takes.

setCollateralSignature.description: Signature (0x...) over the 'bySignature' of a set-collateral approval the quote listed. Only when the quote asked for it.

name: prepare_order
title: Prepare an order (typed data or transaction to sign)
